subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'MENTOR' is coded as 'EMOUPS' and 'OCTAGON' is coded as 'COUBHPO'. What is the code for 'PENCIL' in the given code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• (1) is added to all letter's position value according to the English alphabetic series except first two letters.
 
• First two letters interchange their positions.

So,

 
• 'MENTOR' is coded as 'EMOUPS'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ca70f66129b6a81fdd6a051f040c804c1a9c31bf39466c78c5fd7b5aaa82e7c.png] 

And, 

 
• 'OCTAGON' is coded as 'COUBHPO'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31ec34bc0334338e401872f8f1e96d41863ec97adbbe74f563195871990eb061.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'PENCIL' is coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/481fde2e803ea12fe480f963090dda96e95d27c6b07f5ad67411bebc12b90b50.png] 

Hence, "**EPODJM**" is the correct answer.
